summary: Bug Testing: Page Turning Functionality - Iteration 35. CRITICAL BUG CONFIRMED: Page numbers change but content doesn't update. The bottom navigation buttons directly call setCurrentPage() instead of using the goToPage() function or flipbook's API, causing a disconnect between the page state and the actual flipbook display in desktop mode.

ui_bugs.issue: Page turning buttons don't actually flip pages in desktop/flipbook mode. They update currentPage React state but don't call realisticFlipRef.current.nextPage()/prevPage()
ui_bugs.root_cause: Button onClick handlers directly call setCurrentPage(currentPage + 1) instead of using goToPage() function which properly handles flipbook mode vs mobile mode

integration_issues.issue: The React currentPage state gets updated but RealisticPageFlip component's internal state doesn't change. User sees page indicator change (Cover → Page 1 → Page 2) but actual book content remains on first page.

issues: Image aspect ratio fix appears to be working - using object-fit: contain prevents bleeding over edges

design_issues.screen: Book Reader - Left Side Illustration Page
issues: No text overlays on illustration pages - only showing the image as expected per the fix

action_items: CRITICAL FIX REQUIRED: Change bottom navigation button handlers to use goToPage() function instead of direct setCurrentPage()
Lines 1323-1333: Change prev button onClick from 'setCurrentPage(currentPage - 1)' to 'prevPage()' or 'goToPage(currentPage - 1, "prev")'
Lines 1371-1386: Change next button onClick from 'setCurrentPage(currentPage + 1)' to 'nextPage()' or 'goToPage(currentPage + 1, "next")'
critical_code_review_comments: The goToPage function at line 463 correctly handles both mobile (direct state change) and desktop (flipbook API) modes, but bottom controls bypass it
The RealisticPageFlip component receives 'pages={allPages}' which contains correct 10 pages with different content - API data is correct
Image object-fit change from 'cover' to 'contain' appears to be working correctly - images don't bleed over edges
No text overlays visible on illustration pages in the flipbook left panel - that fix is working

context_for_next_testing_agent: The main bug is in BookReader.js bottom navigation buttons. The prev/next buttons at lines 1323-1333 and 1371-1386 directly call setCurrentPage() which only updates React state but doesn't actually flip the book pages in desktop/flipbook mode. The fix should be simple - change those handlers to use goToPage() function instead. After fix, retest by clicking next button multiple times and verify: 1) Page indicator changes (Cover → Page 1 → Page 2), 2) TEXT CONTENT changes between pages (Page 1 should have different text than Page 2), 3) IMAGE changes between pages.
